history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

Pearl Residences’ Phase 1 3-bedroom units are Type A: 900 sq ft, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The layout has an open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, without a long internal corridor. At the stated RM0.18 per sq ft maintenance rate, that’s about RM162 a month for 900 sq ft, inclusive of sinking fund, subject to the latest project confirmation. That’s the maintenance fee only; loan instalments, utilities and selected pay-per-use clubhouse facilities are separate. I can check the current indicative Type A price to help estimate the loan instalment too.

Thanks, please do check the current Type A price. I’m trying to work out the loan payment along with the regular charges, and whether a car park is included. We’d ideally keep the purchase around RM450,000 if possible.

As a rough reference only, the pricing material I have shows Type A base prices around RM328,000–RM358,000, depending on floor and facing. A car-park premium may apply—references show RM15,000–RM30,000 depending on the unit—so I can’t confirm the total will stay within RM450,000 until the current unit and package are verified. The current price check is already in progress. The materials show both one- and two-car-park configurations, so I’m checking what applies and whether a car park is included.
